payload.title: OmniSource live-fusion replay: fail-closed current-revision and observability adjudication
payload.work_clay: Preserve the 16:35 OmniSource/V2/V3 observability-merge specification in full. Additionally, before every Hostinger/local effect resolve the latest WORK_CREATE/WORK_REVISE event for this work_id and bind the execution receipt to that current spec revision/event id. Any execution started from or reporting an older spec revision is STALE_EXECUTION_RECEIPT evidence only and cannot complete/promote current work. The replay must expose per-delta pre-route dependency projection hash/snapshot identity and per-policy RoutePlan/predicted targets. Derived post-hoc expected branches are oracle labels only. If the experiment does not actually execute receiver delivery->reconstruction->use/effect->ResearchReentryReceipt closure against the owner-fixed OmniSource path, its verdict must remain REVISE or otherwise explicitly state that promotion-grade closure is unexecuted. Hard-coded fault booleans are test-harness assertions, not operational fault receipts; distinguish simulated/in-memory injections from real runtime/repository faults.
payload.reason_clay: A newly committed Hostinger workflow revalidates only the older 16:25 work revision and its experiment hard-codes spec_rev=2, despite newer owner-fixed OmniSource and 16:35 observability revisions. The Work Event Protocol requires effect-time current-spec revalidation. The experiment also derives branch labels and aggregate route metrics without real receiver/reentry execution, so it cannot satisfy the promotion-grade observability/causal-closure gate as written. Fail closed rather than allowing a stale but successful CI run to overwrite current evidence semantics.
payload.completion_clay: Current-revision-aware workflow and experiment record latest work revision event id/spec_rev; stale executions are rejected/quarantined; report contains pre-route projection hash plus per-event route decisions and label provenance; simulated versus operational fault classes are explicit; missing receiver/reentry execution forces REVISE/non-promotion; and a subsequent current-spec Hostinger receipt is separately adjudicated before any V2/V3 promotion. Owner-fixed OmniSource remains active regardless of routing-candidate verdict.
payload.executor_policy: Refresh current work events and repo head immediately before effect. A receipt from the older workflow/spec_rev=2 is admissible only as stale negative/diagnostic evidence. Do not cancel or erase history; append corrective receipts/revisions. No paid training; no Frank self-Harness authority.
invalidators: A newer owner-fixed live-fusion/research-reentry law supersedes OmniSource.
A newer verified current-spec execution fully satisfies the observability, receiver/reentry and operational fault matrix.
A newer work revision supersedes this specification before effect.
